_NOTE: Template — real ~/.claude/settings.json is NOT version-controlled. make setup creates from template or jq-merges: permissions.allow is preserved from the live file (machine-specific), permissions.deny comes from THIS template (global policy — a machine-local deny entry gets overwritten), model/effortLevel/alwaysThinkingEnabled preserved from live, everything else from template. IMPORTANT: the merge is template-first, so a key that exists ONLY in the live settings.json is DROPPED on every make setup — any setting you want to keep must live HERE (this is why includeCoAuthoredBy/agentPushNotifEnabled are in this file). Global skills are VCS'd in dotfiles/skills/ and symlinked to ~/.claude/skills/ (auto-loaded everywhere). Per-repo skills live committed at <repo>/.claude/skills/. MCP_TOOL_TIMEOUT is 86400000 (24h) because it caps EVERY MCP tool call the client makes, including a `job_wait` against sideclaw or research-gateway — those may legitimately block for a very long time (rules/agent-limits.md), so the client-side cap must not be tighter than the server's own wait ceiling. SUBAGENT MODEL: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL pins every subagent (built-in AND custom) to Sonnet; agents/*.md frontmatter `model:` overrides it, an explicit model param on the Agent call overrides both, and `subagent_type: fork` ignores all three by design (forks always inherit the parent). The pin alone is prose past that point — hooks.PreToolUse's `Agent` matcher (model-discipline.ts) is what actually enforces it: denies a worker on `model: fable` outright (no legitimate use) and denies `subagent_type: fork` from a Fable/Opus caller (read from the caller's own transcript, since PreToolUse carries no field for the calling session's model). `model: opus` is deliberately left open — it is the sanctioned escalation for novel-hard logic; that justification stays a one-clause note at the call site, not a hook check. CONTEXT TRIM: permissions.deny holds BARE tool names — a bare name drops the tool's schema from the system prompt entirely; a scoped rule (e.g. Bash(rm *)) does NOT (schema stays, call is blocked). Denied: Artifact (unused; large schema — paired with disableArtifact), EnterPlanMode/ExitPlanMode (plan mode unused). disableClaudeAiConnectors: no claude.ai MCP connectors are configured — kills the auto-fetch (surface reduction, not a token saving). Deliberately NOT denied: most other candidates (NotebookEdit, SendMessage, CronCreate/Delete/List, RemoteTrigger, PushNotification, DesignSync) are already DEFERRED — names only, ~5 tokens each — so denying them costs capability for no real saving; SendMessage is load-bearing for resuming background agents. disableBundledSkills would be the largest saving but removes /code-review, /verify, /schedule et al — declined. Editing deny here propagates to every machine on the next make setup.
